prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, siren bust hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back rose pink hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of three stacked horizontal hot-pink neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, with one hot-pink neon tube loop rising from the center of the bandeau up around her neck as a halter, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of amber neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: sitting on the giant finger with one leg crossed over the other and leaning slightly back, one hand resting on the finger beside her hip and the other hand resting on her knee, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme siren bust hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy steel blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in steel blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: dewy skin with a light highlighter on the cheekbones, a soft peach blush, juicy peach-tinted lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: an enormous real human hand reaches in from the side of the frame with its index finger curled into a loop, the fine skin creases, knuckle wrinkles and fingerprints in sharp macro detail, a natural sheen on the skin and a glossy manicured fingernail as large as a shield; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on the top of the giant curled finger, resting in a real place: a bright Victorian glass greenhouse with a pale tiled floor, tall palms, a waist-high iron rail and a standard-height glass door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, shown softly blurred in the far background with a shallow depth of field. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous finger, knuckle and fingernail around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly visible dangling in the air. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
